newsitem.title: USA: FED ADDS RESERVES VIA OVERNIGHT SYSTEM RPS.
newsitem.headline: FED ADDS RESERVES VIA OVERNIGHT SYSTEM RPS.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system on Wednesday via overnight system repurchase agreements, the New York Fed confirmed.
The operation was expected, as the Fed was seen facing a large add need on the final day of its maintenance period.
The add need is seen swelling to $6.5 billion in the next period, analysts forecast.
Federal funds were tight, trading above their 5-1/2 percent target rate at 5-11/16 percent at the time of the intervention. The high level was said due to period-end pressures.
